pre_registration.name: learn_from_the_closing_line
pre_registration.status: pre-registered 2026-10-08, before any fit below (study 3 still running; its result unseen)
pre_registration.motivation: The engine's edge shows up as line movement: its bets see the line move their way 67-80% of the time. The closing line is the market's best estimate of the total, so close - open is a nearly noise-free reading of how wrong the opener was (its spread is about 2-3 points, against about 17 for final total - opener). A model trained to predict the move learns the opener's systematic errors from far less noisy targets than final scores; since the close is close to unbiased, E[total - opener] is about the predicted move plus a constant.

candidates.M1_close_target: mean model (locked features, ridge, season weights) trained on close - open instead of total - open; the variance model and a constant are then fitted on total - open - predicted move; calibrator, eligibility and products as locked.
candidates.M2_move_feature: the locked engine plus one mean feature: the predicted move from a ridge model on the locked features, trained on close - open within the same training seasons.

pre_registration.selection_rule: as study_2 (both eras: lower log loss AND higher matched-volume ROI at -110); the better pooled matched ROI if both qualify
pre_registration.confirmation: as study_2, on the sealed 2021-26 seasons, run once
pre_registration.disclosure: Opening and closing lines of all seasons were used before as data; no close-target model was ever fitted.
